title: nosetest errors when "xlrd" isn't installed

labels.name: Testing
labels.description: pandas testing functions or related to the test suite

body:
Maybe this is because I have openpyxl but not xlrd installed.

Anyway, I guess the tests should be skipped instead of throwing an error.
